selection_rule: top6 RMS thickness-error-scaled Jacobian columns on this sparse training nominal only; no holdout selection
error_distribution: independent uniform [-0.002,+0.002] per layer; separate systematic uniform [-0.002,+0.002] shared by every layer. Test assumption only, not user acceptance requirement.
final_grid: original 1nm wavelengths over all 4 bands and 25 angles at 0.5deg; strict R<0.03 IR, R>=0.99 HR
fairness: Same initial design, target inequalities, variable set/bounds, sparse training grid and candidate-evaluation ceiling. No nominal penalty/constraint in robustness. Matched nominal-only control uses same sweep/pattern and only nominal violation; skips scenario forwards because they do not enter its scalar. Thus not equal wall time or equal forward count.
